title: Tech Note: Single Sign On with Lightweight Directory Access Protocol
author: Tai BUI, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Native LDAP commands introduced in 4D v15 remain valid and supported today; LDAP itself is still a widely used enterprise directory standard, so the core commands and concepts here are still current. The specific SSO demo (auto-launching Skype/FileZilla via LAUNCH EXTERNAL PROCESS with stored credentials) is a dated, fragile pattern that modern security practice would avoid in favor of proper SSO protocols like SAML/OAuth/OIDC.
related_updates: 4D's LDAP command set has remained largely stable since v15
Modern SSO implementations favor SAML/OAuth2/OIDC over storing plaintext credentials for local app launch
